title: 두 명
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop rock track featuring distorted electric guitars and a driving drum kit. The arrangement is centered around a male vocal performance that transitions from melodic verses to aggressive, belted choruses. A gritty bass guitar follows the kick drum patterns. The tempo is 145 BPM in the key of B minor. The production uses modern compression and bright EQ on the vocals, with layered vocal harmonies in the chorus. Electric guitars utilize palm-muted chugging in the verses and wide-panned power chords in the chorus. A subtle synthesizer pad provides harmonic density in the background.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[distorted electric guitar riff, driving drum beat]

[Verse 1]
[male vocals]
방송 속에 나는 웃어
다정하게 말하지
근데 눈물이 자나 렌즈가 건조
해서야 [palm-muted guitar chugging]
카메라가 잘라낸 열 시간이 있어
조용하고 지루한 열 시간이 있어
편집이 나를 만들어 두 시간이
열 시간을 덮어

[Chorus]
[full band, belted vocals]
나는 두 명이야
어느 쪽이 나야
두 시간짜리 나 열 시간짜리 나
거울아 [cymbal crash]
대답해
